# Integrations

Connect Cloudflare One to identity providers, SaaS applications, and endpoint security vendors

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of pages or to a more detailed `llms.txt` index for a section. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Cloud and SaaS integrations

- [CASB documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/cloud-and-saas/llms.txt): Scan SaaS applications and cloud environments for data security issues

## Identity providers

- [Identity providers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/index.md): Identity providers in Zero Trust integrations.
- [Cloudflare as identity provider](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/cloudflare/index.md): Use Cloudflare as an identity provider for Access policies, allowing authentication based on Cloudflare account membership.
- [One-time PIN login](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/one-time-pin/index.md): One-time PIN login in Zero Trust integrations.
- [Generic OIDC](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/generic-oidc/index.md): Generic OIDC in Zero Trust integrations.

- [IdP federation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/idp-federation/index.md): Share an identity provider across multiple Cloudflare accounts in your organization using IdP federation.
- [Active Directory (SAML)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/adfs/index.md): Integrate Active Directory with Cloudflare One for secure identity management.
- [Amazon Cognito](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/identity-providers/awscognito-oidc/index.md): Amazon Cognito in Zero Trust integrations.
